sources.title: Where to Find My Models Now - Civitai
sources.snippet: As of May 28, 2025, I've published a total of 446 models on CivitAI, including checkpoints, LoRAs, and TIs — most of them focused on celebrity LoRAs and TIs. Due to CivitAI's new policy banning celebrity content, all related models have been taken down. So, I'm moving them to other platforms. For now, you can find and download my models on these three platforms. I'll keep looking for better ...
